name: NeRF for Object Segmentation
definition: A NeRF-based component that estimates scene geometry and predicts semantic labels (occlusion masks) simultaneously. It uses 'area encoding' to represent the probability that a sampling point belongs to an occluded area, leveraging the correlation between geometry estimation and semantic label prediction.
summary: NeRF for Object Segmentation extends standard NeRF by introducing area encoding to jointly estimate scene geometry and predict semantic occlusion masks for view-consistent segmentation.
